cases.translation: Sing joyfully to God, our strength.
cases.explain: The preposition в/на (implicit in the song address) takes the prepositional case.

cases.translation: Shout aloud to God of Jacob.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession or association in 'Бог Иакова' (God of Jacob).

cases.translation: Let the music sound, strike the tambourines.
cases.explain: Музыка is the subject of the imperative грянет (let sound), requiring the nominative case.

cases.translation: Blow the trumpet at the festival of the New Moon.
cases.explain: The genitive case follows the noun праздник to show what the festival celebrates.

cases.translation: I heard a voice I did not know.
cases.explain: The verb услышал (heard) takes the direct object голос in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Я снял тяжелую ношу с его ___.
cases.translation: I removed the heavy burden from his shoulders.
cases.explain: The preposition с (from) takes the genitive case; plural genitive is плеч.

cases.sentence: Открой свои ___, и я наполню их.
cases.translation: Open your mouth, and I will fill it.
cases.explain: The verb открой (open) takes the direct object in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Но народ мой не слушал моего ___, Израиль не покорялся мне.
cases.translation: But my people did not listen to my voice; Israel did not obey me.
cases.explain: The verb слушал (listened) with its object takes the genitive case in Russian.

reading.ru: Радостно пойте Богу нашей твердыни, восклицайте Богу Иакова.
reading.question: What is the people commanded to do?
options: Sing joyfully and shout aloud to God
reading.correct: Sing joyfully and shout aloud to God
reading.explain: The opening commands 'пойте' (sing) and 'восклицайте' (shout aloud) to God.

reading.ru: Пусть грянет музыка, ударьте в бубны и троньте струны сладкозвучной арфы и лиры.
reading.question: What musical instruments are mentioned?

reading.ru: Трубите в рок в праздник Новолуния и в полнолуние в день нашего праздника.
reading.question: When should the trumpet be blown?
options: At the new moon festival and full moon
reading.correct: At the new moon festival and full moon
reading.explain: The verse specifies 'в праздник Новолуния и в полнолуние' — at the New Moon festival and full moon.

reading.ru: Я снял тяжелую ношу с его плеч, и руки его освободились от корзин.
reading.question: What did God do for the people?
options: Removed the burden from their shoulders and freed their hands from baskets
reading.correct: Removed the burden from their shoulders and freed their hands from baskets
reading.explain: God's action is described as 'снял ношу с его плеч' and 'руки его освободились от корзин' — removed the burden and freed their hands.

reading.ru: Я — Господь твой Бог, тот, кто вывел тебя из земли египетской.
reading.question: How does God identify himself?
options: As the Lord your God who brought you out of Egypt
As the creator of all things
As the judge of all people
reading.correct: As the Lord your God who brought you out of Egypt
reading.explain: God identifies himself as 'Господь твой Бог, тот, кто вывел тебя из земли египетской' — the Lord your God who brought you out of Egypt.

reading.ru: Но народ мой не слушал моего голоса, Израиль не покорялся мне.
reading.question: What was the people's response to God's commands?
options: They did not listen and did not obey
reading.correct: They did not listen and did not obey
reading.explain: The text states 'не слушал моего голоса' and 'не покорялся' — did not listen and did not obey.
